pr_title: Fix default health bar having a very weird anchor point in the skin editor

issue_context.title: Origin of `DefaultHealthDisplay` skin component behaves abnormally
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

Unlike every other skin component, the origin point of `DefaultHealthDisplay` completely detaches from the component itself, even without resizing (although resizing allows the bug to be displayed more prominently.)

### Screenshots or videos

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37262651/214528402-5e022568-2f95-4b54-b798-046f59a04dba.png)

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37262651/214528539-562ad0f6-c66e-4619-a85f-f2688aaf0ff3.mp4



### Version

master build (commit efe57f2)
